item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di khyung sgom bdag gis bkod / nyes 'gal mchis na ma sring khyod la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob cig/ de ltar gdams pa'i lung bstan mchid 'di ni/ bdag gis smras ltar khyod kyis thub par gyis/ yun gyi slar yang mi 'bral mjal bar smon/ nga rang mkha' dbyings bde ba'i zhing du 'gro skal ldan gshen po'i thugs kyis dgongs par mdzod/ de skad gsungs nas bya phran tshogs dang bcas/ lding skor gsum byas mkha' la 'phur nas song //
